text: Pinehurst Grocers runs 60 stores, and its stockout report is always two days late. This series builds the fix, start to finish -- meeting the people who sign off on it.

Carol Jennings, VP of Store Operations, called this meeting. Derek Mosley builds the stockout report by hand for 22 stores. Raj Patel's team already gets a nightly export from every store -- nobody built the next step.
The incident that got Pinehurst to pay for a fix: this July 4th weekend, 11 stores ran out of buns and 8 ran out of ground beef all weekend -- $42,000 lost, found two days too late.
The real problem isn't the data -- it already lands every night. The problem is everything after that is manual. That gap, not the source system, is what this series replaces.
Next: turning Carol's 'we need this faster' into an actual number everyone can build against.
